subject: Marine Works - Grand Manan - Saint John, NB
text:
Marine Works - Grand Manan - Saint John, NB
Dredging operations are underway in Saint John Harbour and Courtney Bay. Dredging is conducted 24 hours a day, seven days a week and performed via barge-mounted dredges and disposed via bottom dumping scows. Mariners are requested to give the dredging equipment a low wake and wide berth. Caution.
